About.title: About Me
About.content: Amsterdam-based mathematician, engineer, and educator. I started tutoring at 15, charging €10/hour when others charged €5 — because I went from a 4 to a 10 in mathematics. That journey ignited a passion for teaching that's now spanned 15+ years. Today I'm pursuing two Master's degrees simultaneously while building production data systems.
